description: Tier 6 stop-hooks registry for session exit validation

hooks.name: stop_on_uncommitted_critical
hooks.description: Prevents exit when CRITICAL-classified files have uncommitted changes

hooks.name: stop_on_orphan_children
hooks.description: Prevents exit when background agents are still running

hooks.name: stop_on_open_lock
hooks.description: Auto-releases file locks held by this session on exit

hooks.name: stop_on_open_claim
hooks.description: Prevents exit when claims are held without completion

hooks.name: stop_on_incomplete_pipeline
hooks.description: Prevents exit when extraction/forge pipelines are half-finished

hooks.name: stop_on_dirty_registry
hooks.description: Prevents exit when registries have unflushed changes

hooks.name: stop_on_failing_tests
hooks.description: Prevents exit when loop-scope tests are failing

hooks.name: stop_on_build_error
hooks.description: Prevents exit when build has new TS errors

hooks.name: stop_on_sx_fail
hooks.description: Prevents exit when files touched have S(x) < 0.70

hooks.name: stop_on_awareness_degraded
hooks.description: Warns when awareness score dropped below threshold

hooks.name: stop_on_svi_regression
hooks.description: Warns when SVI decreased during session

hooks.name: stop_on_unregistered_asset
hooks.description: Warns when new assets not registered

hooks.name: stop_on_orphan_engine
hooks.description: Warns when engine created without dispatcher wiring

hooks.name: stop_on_missing_tests
hooks.description: Warns when engine/feature created without test coverage

hooks.name: stop_on_extraction_incomplete
hooks.description: Warns when PDF/video extraction is incomplete

hooks.name: stop_on_roadmap_drift
hooks.description: Warns when work doesn't match claimed roadmap unit

hooks.name: stop_on_uncommitted_memory
hooks.description: Warns when memory entries edited but not synced

hooks.name: stop_on_stale_handoff
hooks.description: Warns when handoff file is >24h old

hooks.name: stop_on_broken_imports
hooks.description: Warns when import statements point to missing files

hooks.name: stop_on_circular_deps
hooks.description: Warns when new circular dependency introduced

hooks.name: stop_on_undocumented_action
hooks.description: Warns when MCP action exists without schema/doc

hooks.name: stop_on_unsafe_gcode
hooks.description: Warns when G-code generated with safety warnings

hooks.name: stop_on_duplicate_created
hooks.description: Warns when duplicate asset bypassed dedup guard

hooks.name: stop_on_formula_uncited
hooks.description: Warns when formula exists without provenance citation

hooks.name: stop_on_skill_unwired
hooks.description: Warns when skill created without hook anchor

hooks.name: stop_on_hook_unregistered
hooks.description: Warns when hook file not in registry
